subject: Science
stem: The sharp, pointed teeth located at the corners of the mouth (between the incisors and premolars), primarily used for tearing food, are called:
explanation: Human teeth have four types by function: incisors (flat, front, for cutting), canines (pointed, for tearing), premolars and molars (broad, back, for grinding/chewing) — canines are notably more prominent/developed in carnivorous animals for tearing meat.
